staged_move_leaves.policy: No independent crate move leaf is executable today. Recommend staged unblocks, then an atomic nested-workspace rehome (or explicit sub-workspace under kernel/), then zero-crate residual delete only.

stages.title: Disposition inventory (docs only)
actions: Do not open a new active move-plan
Do not move or delete crates
stages.exit_criteria: PR merged; inventory is the reference for later execute cards

stages.title: Unblock codemod workspace.dependencies rewrite (B2)
owned_paths_hint: tools/ or libs path for oya-reorg-codemod cargo rewrite
actions: Extend rewrite_dep_tables_recursive (or sibling) to rewrite [workspace.dependencies] path deps
Add dry-run oracle that fails if vacated path deps remain
Prove on a fixture workspace before any kernel apply
stages.exit_criteria: Codemod dry-run on a synthetic nested workspace rewrites all 5 path edges; no silent green

stages.title: Unblock path-literal / include! couplings (B3)
options: Codemod gains include!/include_bytes!/include_str! relative-path rewrite for known old→new layout
OR refactor tests-host to depend on a host-testable package without cross-dir include! of sibling crate sources
Recount path-ups after face layout (adapters under kernel/adapters/* change ../ depth to out/)
stages.exit_criteria: All include macros that leave their package dir are either rewritten by tool or eliminated by refactor; CI host-tests still pass

stages.title: Resolve B1 destination coexistence

options.name: nested_subworkspace_under_kernel
options.description: Home kuberos as kernel/kuberos/ (or kernel/frame/) with its own Cargo.toml/.cargo/rust-toolchain — parallel nested workspace beside asterinas members, avoiding single-valued file collision. Face layout can still be applied inside the subworkspace.
cons: Deviates from pure ports/core/adapters at kernel/ root faces
Requires plan amend from kernel-move-plan.BLOCKED face paths

options.name: merge_into_kernel_faces_after_deinherit
options.description: Land into kernel/ports|core|adapters as BLOCKED plan states; de-inherit edition/rust-version on all manifests; split .cargo/rust-toolchain via per-crate or build-script strategy (hard — Cargo walk-up).
cons: High risk to asterinas std harness

options.name: relocate_asterinas_first
options.description: Move asterinas crates to a dedicated nested home (e.g. kernel/harness-asterinas workspace root elsewhere) so kernel/ root becomes free for kuberos face layout.
cons: Extra move-plan / dual-home churn; asterinas already landed per ADR-0611

stages.recommendation: S3-A preferred under Essentialism + Chesterton: preserve both workspaces working, keep registry home kernel/, avoid fighting Cargo single-valued files. Amend blocked plan paths accordingly before execute.
stages.exit_criteria: Written ADR or plan amend choosing S3-A/B/C; both workspaces build in chosen shape on a dry-run branch

stages.title: Atomic kuberos rehome (single move-class PR after singleton free)
stages.move_plan: Amend specs/reorg/kernel-move-plan.BLOCKED.json → executable kernel-move-plan.json (or successor name) only when S1–S3 exit; do not run concurrent second move-plan

leaves.coupling: Must land with or before adapters (implementors); not alone if consumers break
Lowest internal coupling; still workspace-membership coupled until workspace root moves
Depends on hal + arch feature selection

crates: 13 nested freestanding packages ride along (not separate leaves)
leaves.coupling: Atomic with parent dirs; never split nested user-* sources into independent move rows

stages.execute_shape: Prefer ONE atomic move PR for the whole nested workspace once unblocked (blast-radius contained by pre-proven dry-run). Sub-leaves above are ordering guidance inside the plan, not permission for sequential half-moved dual-homes.
stages.exit_criteria: All 20 packages live under kernel/; cloud/cloud-kernel package_crate_count == 0; de-brand names applied; dry-run oracle green

stages.title: Zero-crate residual only — delete empty cloud/cloud-kernel absorb
stages.condition: package_crate_count == 0 AND no required artifacts remain AND capability-registry current_dirs updated AND BUCK/accounting consumers updated
actions: Close RR-CLOUD-KERNEL-DEL only if residual delete is the approved end-state (not live-crate delete)
stages.exit_criteria: Single home kernel/ for capability; dual-home debt 0 for this pair

explicit_non_leaves: Do not move a single nested user-* package alone
Do not move to os/ or compute/
Do not delete cloud/cloud-kernel while package crates remain (RR-CLOUD-KERNEL-DEL as live-crate delete is rejected by this inventory)
Do not execute kernel-move-plan.BLOCKED until B1–B3 clear
